title: 獅子洋隧道
summary: 國家鐵路局公開技術資料列獅子洋隧道10.8公里、雙孔單線，並記錄2011年12月通車及軟土、土岩複合與岩層的變化。本課從地層切換到結構和軌道平順性，串接長距離盾構、接合測量、列車氣動及救援；公開設計數字與本課假想模型分開呈現。
summaryEn: The National Railway Administration records Shiziyang as 10.8 km with twin single-track bores, opening in December 2011 through soft soil, mixed and rock strata. This course links ground transitions to structural and track geometry, long shield drives, connection surveys, train aerodynamics and rescue, keeping published design context separate from teaching calculations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「破碎帶連通與預報更新」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Fault connectivity and forecast updating": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響獅子洋隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shiziyang Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 獅子洋總隧道與盾構段的範圍不同，教材先確認雙孔單線的計量方式，不把兩孔相加當列車行程。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Total tunnel and shielded sections have different extents; define twin single-track measurement without adding both bores into train travel distance. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=19.6 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=19.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=19.6 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 獅子洋總隧道與盾構段的範圍不同，教材先確認雙孔單線的計量方式，不把兩孔相加當列車行程。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Total tunnel and shielded sections have different extents; define twin single-track measurement without adding both bores into train travel distance. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
獅子洋總隧道與盾構段的範圍不同，教材先確認雙孔單線的計量方式，不把兩孔相加當列車行程。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Total tunnel and shielded sections have different extents; define twin single-track measurement without adding both bores into train travel distance.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 獅子洋總隧道與盾構段的範圍不同，教材先確認雙孔單線的計量方式，不把兩孔相加當列車行程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Total tunnel and shielded sections have different extents; define twin single-track measurement without adding both bores into train travel distance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=19.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=19.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為21.56 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=19.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=19.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 21.56 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=19.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=19.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為21.56 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=19.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=19.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 21.56 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
原創教學假設：長度=19.6 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Original teaching assumptions: length=19.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=19.6 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=19.6 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=19.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=19.6 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把雙孔工程量當單趟長度會使時間和容量估算加倍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using twin-bore quantities as one journey length doubles time and capacity inputs. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
optionsEn: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把雙孔工程量當單趟長度會使時間和容量估算加倍。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using twin-bore quantities as one journey length doubles time and capacity inputs. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把雙孔工程量當單趟長度會使時間和容量估算加倍。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Using twin-bore quantities as one journey length doubles time and capacity inputs. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把雙孔工程量當單趟長度會使時間和容量估算加倍。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using twin-bore quantities as one journey length doubles time and capacity inputs.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 把雙孔工程量當單趟長度會使時間和容量估算加倍。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using twin-bore quantities as one journey length doubles time and capacity inputs. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「破碎帶連通性」如何影響獅子洋隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault-zone connectivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shiziyang Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 公開資料記載軟土至土岩複合及岩層變化，本課研究混合面比例和裂隙如何共同改變掘進反應。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「破碎帶連通性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Published ground transitions motivate analysis of mixed-face proportions and fractures that change boring response together. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault-zone connectivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=390 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=390 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「破碎帶連通性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fault-zone connectivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新
knowledge.text: 公開資料記載軟土至土岩複合及岩層變化，本課研究混合面比例和裂隙如何共同改變掘進反應。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。
knowledge.textEn: Published ground transitions motivate analysis of mixed-face proportions and fractures that change boring response together. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" is correct?
options: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
公開資料記載軟土至土岩複合及岩層變化，本課研究混合面比例和裂隙如何共同改變掘進反應。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Published ground transitions motivate analysis of mixed-face proportions and fractures that change boring response together.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料記載軟土至土岩複合及岩層變化，本課研究混合面比例和裂隙如何共同改變掘進反應。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Published ground transitions motivate analysis of mixed-face proportions and fractures that change boring response together. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「破碎帶連通性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fault-zone connectivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=390 m²。Q=k i A=0.004095 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0045045 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=390 m². Q=k i A=0.004095 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0045045 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對齊扭矩波動、地質揭露與出渣粒徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align torque fluctuation, exposures and spoil grading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=390 m²。Q=k i A=0.004095 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0045045 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=390 m². Q=k i A=0.004095 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0045045 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「破碎帶連通與預報更新」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fault connectivity and forecast updating", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=390 m²。
灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=390 m².
Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=390 m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=390 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「破碎帶連通性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fault-zone connectivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊扭矩波動、地質揭露與出渣粒徑。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align torque fluctuation, exposures and spoil grading. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：對齊扭矩波動、地質揭露與出渣粒徑。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Align torque fluctuation, exposures and spoil grading. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把所有扭矩峰當岩石變硬會漏掉面內不均和設備因素。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all torque peaks as harder rock misses face heterogeneity and equipment causes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對齊扭矩波動、地質揭露與出渣粒徑。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Align torque fluctuation, exposures and spoil grading. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：對齊扭矩波動、地質揭露與出渣粒徑。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
knowledge.textEn: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Align torque fluctuation, exposures and spoil grading. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fault connectivity and forecast updating"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對齊扭矩波動、地質揭露與出渣粒徑。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Align torque fluctuation, exposures and spoil grading.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 對齊扭矩波動、地質揭露與出渣粒徑。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align torque fluctuation, exposures and spoil grading. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「破碎帶連通性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fault-zone connectivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把所有扭矩峰當岩石變硬會漏掉面內不均和設備因素。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating all torque peaks as harder rock misses face heterogeneity and equipment causes. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把所有扭矩峰當岩石變硬會漏掉面內不均和設備因素。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。
knowledge.textEn: Treating all torque peaks as harder rock misses face heterogeneity and equipment causes. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「破碎帶連通與預報更新」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
把所有扭矩峰當岩石變硬會漏掉面內不均和設備因素。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Treating all torque peaks as harder rock misses face heterogeneity and equipment causes.
quiz.explanation: 把所有扭矩峰當岩石變硬會漏掉面內不均和設備因素。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating all torque peaks as harder rock misses face heterogeneity and equipment causes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
